review_hook.title: Review hook
review_hook.description: The agent reviews what it made during the work and at the end. It fixes problems on the spot and reports what it could not fix. It reviews after creating charts, analytics, wrangling steps and so on. When it writes custom R for wrangling that a product command can do, it is stopped and asked to use the product command instead. Before its final report, it also checks the whole note or dashboard as an image. Off by default.
